contextReview.basis: Direct review: clear, sunny daytime East Asian urban running routes: a tree-lined riverside promenade with a city skyline, a sloping residential lane with a stone step, a shaded pavement past hedges and low apartment blocks, a street-side drinking fountain, and a riverside railing with apartment blocks and a bridge; hard direct sun with sharp shadows, blue sky and a visible sheen of sweat on skin. No rain is depicted; the wet paving at the fountain is fountain water. The East Asian urban region and the humid setting are the producer's reviewed mapping; humid is a styling setting, not a measurement. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: The handoff and READY.json record that the user explicitly approved these five female running editorials and full automation of this batch (userApprovedEditorials true, currentBatchExplicitAuthorization true; 2026-11-07). Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The stone step, handrail, potted plant and the sloping lane are the setting, not products. She bends forward to tie a lace, so the tee's back and the shorts' waist are partly hidden and conservatively reconstructed, and the watch dial is inferred. Both runners and both socks are visible and listed as pairs. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

findings: Actual worn silhouettes, colors and accessories matched. Hidden fronts restored conservatively.

deck.ko: 코랄 티와 차콜 쇼츠로 가볍게 정돈한 낮 러닝.
deck.en: Coral and charcoal keep the daytime run simple.
deck.de: Koralle und Anthrazit halten den Tageslauf unkompliziert.

intro.ko: 낮은 계단에 발을 올리고 느슨해진 신발 끈을 묶습니다.
intro.en: A low step offers a place to retie a loose lace.
intro.de: Eine niedrige Stufe bietet Platz, einen lockeren Schnürsenkel neu zu binden.

body.ko: 코랄 반소매의 작은 흰 어깨 포인트가 차콜 쇼츠의 옆선과 어울립니다. 흰 양말과 연회색 신발은 강한 상의 색을 부드럽게 받쳐 줍니다. 손목의 검정 시계 외에는 장식을 줄여 숙이는 동작에서도 착장이 간결하게 읽힙니다.
body.en: Small white shoulder accents on the coral tee connect with the curved lines of the charcoal shorts. White socks and pale gray shoes soften the strong upper color. With only a black watch at the wrist, the outfit stays clear even during the bent-over movement.
body.de: Kleine weiße Schulterakzente des korallfarbenen Shirts passen zu den Linien der anthrazitfarbenen Shorts. Weiße Socken und hellgraue Schuhe mildern die kräftige Oberteilfarbe. Eine schwarze Uhr bleibt der einzige Handgelenkakzent, sodass der Look auch beim Vorbeugen klar wirkt.

pull.en: A small reset starts the next step.
pull.de: Ein kurzer Neustart führt zum nächsten Schritt.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A small reset starts the next step.

tip.ko: 신발 끈은 좌우 길이를 맞추고 상의 밑단은 쇼츠 트임 위로 자연스럽게 내려두세요.
tip.en: Balance the lace lengths and let the tee fall naturally above the shorts' side splits.
tip.de: Die Schnürsenkel gleich lang halten und das Shirt locker über den Seitenschlitzen tragen.
